blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas’ early exit, leading to the country’s worst-ever finish in Asian Games men’s basketball, left fans disappointed and even drew sharp criticism from those on the outside looking in. Reaction was mostly negative toward the way Gilas was blown out by China, 105-61, which put an abrupt end to its defense of the gold it won three years ago, while also failing to avoid a loss of 38 points or more that would have assured coach Tim Cone’s wards a spot in the quarterfinals.
